publish_hinfo.description: Publish HINFO (hardware/OS) records for this host

publish_mx.description: Publish MX (mail server) records for the local domain

publish_srv.description: Publish SRV records for local services

publish_txt.description: Publish TXT records for local services

publish_ftp.description: Publish FTP service (requires FTP daemon running)

publish_webdav.description: Publish WebDAV service (requires WebDAV daemon running)

publish_airprint.description: Publish AirPrint service (requires CUPS AirPrint support)

publish_apia.description: Publish Avahi API service (advanced/debug use only)

publish_resolv_conf.description: Publish DNS resolver configuration (e.g., upstream DNS servers)

rate_limit_interval_usec.description: Rate-limit interval in microseconds; packets beyond the burst are dropped

rate_limit_burst.description: Maximum packets allowed per rate-limit interval

enable_wide_area.description: Enable Wide Area mDNS (not recommended without explicit infrastructure)

enable_reflector.description: Enable reflector mode: forward mDNS packets across subnets (for multi-subnet networks)

reflect_ipv4.description: Reflect IPv4 mDNS packets across subnets when reflector is enabled

reflect_ipv6.description: Reflect IPv6 mDNS packets across subnets when reflector is enabled

min_ttl.description: Minimum TTL (in seconds) for mDNS-resolved hostnames; prevents aggressive caching

rlimit_nofile.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors for the avahi-daemon process

rlimit_core.description: Maximum size of core dumps (0 = use system default)
